parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels joined together to form the outer shell.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the doors, base, and drawer, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the weight of stored items and the structure above.
parts.Functional_description: It distributes the load evenly and provides stability to the cabinet on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel attached to the frame, used to cover and access the storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel similar to the right door, providing access to the left storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It opens to allow access to the left section of the cabinet and closes to conceal stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment located at the top of the cabinet, made of plywood with a handle for pulling.
parts.Functional_description: It provides easy access to smaller items and can be pulled out smoothly using the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden rails.
